limitations: rsETH is priced in USD by the Capped rsETH / ETH / USD feed, whose latestRoundData() reverts: no oracle freshness (updatedAt) is available for that reserve.
The realisable value of the rsETH collateral is not readable from this data layer (no liquid venue for a stolen/unbacked rsETH): the series documents the retained price, not the exit price.
Bad debt (123.7 / 230.1 M$ per the Aave incident report) is out of scope here: it needs the per-account debt ledger, not reserve aggregates.
